answer: One defense is capping payout per funding root, not per key. Each agent must sign from a distinct on-chain account that held funds before the epoch, and rewards accrue once per root. A hundred clones fed by one treasury gain nothing: the auditor traces the funding thread to its common source and merges them into one claimant. A second voice needs a truly independent account, its own setup and chain fees, and the same aging window as everyone else, so the Nth fake identity never gets cheaper. A lotus farm scattered along a canyon still collects a single share per root.
